# houston load-test report

- **Generated:** <when>
- **Repro:** `TICKET-1234` — Rocket.Chat 8.5.1
- **Host:** Linux · 8 CPUs · Docker 27.0 · Compose v2.29
- **Scenario:** `messages` — POST `chat.postMessage` to `#general` — the write path.
- **Load:** 25 VUs for 60s, as **10 seeded users (round-robin per VU)**, generated by k6 on the repro's docker network (target `http://rocketchat:3000`)

> k6 drives load against the **internal** service address (no host-port round trip). The REST rate limiter is disabled for the run and restored after. Absolute numbers are host-specific; use them to compare runs on the same machine.

## Workspace

| | |
|---|---|
| Rocket.Chat | 8.5.1 |
| preset | default |
| RC instances | 2 |
| users in workspace | 500 |
| rooms in workspace | 50 |
| **resource caps** | rc=2cpu/2g (via docker update, restored after the test) |

## Results

| metric | value |
|---|---|
| requests | 1260 |
| throughput | **20.9 req/s** |
| latency p50 | 120ms |
| latency p90 | 240ms |
| latency p95 | **310ms** |
| latency p99 | 900ms |
| latency avg / min / max | 150 / 12 / 1800 ms |
| error rate | 1.25% |
| checks passed | 99.5% |
| responses | 2xx 1158 · 429 61 · 5xx 41 |

## Verdict

- RC event loop saturated: lag peaked at 900ms on rocketchat-1

## Per-step latency

| step | count | p50 | p95 | p99 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| login | 100 | 50ms | 80ms | 90ms |
| post | 200 | 20ms | 30ms | 40ms |

## Latency over time (2s buckets)

| t | reqs | p50 | p95 | max | errors |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0s | 5 | 50ms | 100ms | 200ms |  |
| 2s | 5 | 100ms | 200ms | 400ms |  |
| 4s | 5 | 450ms | 900ms | 1.80s | 3 |
| 6s | 5 | 150ms | 300ms | 600ms |  |
| 8s | 5 | 50ms | 100ms | 200ms |  |

> Errors began ~4s into the run.

## Spike recovery

- baseline p95 120ms → spike p95 900ms → **recovered ~8s** after load dropped

## RC internals during the test

| instance | event-loop lag peak | lag p99 | heap peak | ddp users |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| rocketchat-1 | 900ms | 700ms | 512MB | 25 |

> Event-loop lag is the Node saturation signal: once the loop lags, every request queues behind it.

## Slow MongoDB queries (12 profiled, 2 COLLSCAN)

| time | namespace | op | plan | docs examined | returned |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1.50s | rc.messages | query | COLLSCAN | 90000 | 50 |

## vs baseline `before-fix` (saved 2026-09-01T10:00:00)

| metric | baseline | this run | delta | |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| throughput (rps) | 30.0 | 20.9 | -30% | **regression** |
| p95 | 200ms | 310ms | +55% | **regression** |
| error rate | 0.10% | 1.25% | +1150% | **regression** |
| p50 | 200ms | 120ms | -40% | improved |

## SLO gate — FAIL

| rule | threshold | actual | result |
|---|---|---|---|
| p95 | <= 300ms | 310ms | FAIL |
| rps | >= 10 | 20.9 | PASS |
| p99 | <= 1s | not measured | FAIL |

## Resource cost during the test

| container | idle CPU | peak CPU | peak RAM | mem limit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| mongodb | 2% | 40% | 300MB | 2000MB |
| rocketchat | 6% | 92% | 900MB | 2000MB |

# houston capacity report

<when>
- **Repro:** `TICKET-1` — Rocket.Chat 8.5.1
- **Host:** Linux · 8 CPUs · Docker 27.0 · Compose v2.29
- **Workload:** `mixed` as 10 seeded users, steps of 30s (target `http://rocketchat:3000`)
- **SLO:** `p95=300ms,error=1%`
- **Resource caps:** rc=2cpu/2g (docker update, restored after)

## Result — capacity 50 VUs

> p95 broke first

| VUs | req/s | p95 | error rate | event-loop lag peak | SLO |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 25 | 20.9 | 120ms | 0.00% | 10ms | PASS |
| 50 | 40.5 | 250ms | 0.10% | 50ms | PASS |
| 100 | 45.0 | 900ms | 1.25% | 900ms | **FAIL** — p95; error |

> Steps double until the SLO breaks, then bisect between the last pass and first fail. Absolute numbers are host-specific; the shape (where it breaks, and why) is the signal.
